# Eire Reborn - Update 6 (Return of the Celts) effects, generated by tools/gen_script_celt.py

# County scope (root = the ruler): the county takes the ruler's culture and resents it for a while.
eir_celt_convert_county_effect = {
	set_county_culture = root.culture
	add_county_modifier = {
		modifier = eir_mainland_resistance_modifier
		years = 15
	}
}

# Character scope: half of the counties of the Empire of France in the realm that are not of the ruler's culture take it.
eir_celt_half_convert_france_effect = {
	every_sub_realm_county = {
		limit = {
			empire = title:e_france
			NOT = { culture = root.culture }
		}
		random = {
			chance = 50
			eir_celt_convert_county_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
